candidate_invariant.name: BINARY_IMPLICATION_CONGRUENCE
candidate_invariant.definition: Let B(F) be the subformula of all clauses of width at most 2. Build its implication graph. If no contradiction SCC exists, identify literals that lie in the same strongly connected component and quotient all variables/literals by these forced equivalence classes.

polynomial_computation.implication_graph: Each binary clause (a OR b) contributes not-a -> b and not-b -> a; unit clauses are treated as doubled binary clauses.
polynomial_computation.scc: Strongly connected components are computable in linear time in the size of B(F).
polynomial_computation.substitution: Choose one deterministic representative literal per SCC-pair and substitute all equivalent literals throughout F; simplify tautologies and duplicate literals/clauses.
polynomial_computation.charged_cost: Polynomial in the current formula size.

exactness_theorem.contradiction_case: If some literal l and its complement not-l lie in the same SCC of B(F), then B(F) is UNSAT and therefore F is UNSAT.
exactness_theorem.equivalence_case: If literals l and r lie in the same SCC and B(F) is satisfiable, B(F) entails l iff r. Every model of F is a model of B(F), hence F entails l iff r. Replacing each SCC-equivalence class by a representative therefore preserves satisfiability exactly.
exactness_theorem.strict_progress: Whenever a nontrivial SCC-equivalence class contains literals of distinct underlying variables, at least one variable can be removed without branching and without a SAT oracle.

rigid_core_witness.sign_flip_rigidity: On support {x,y}, the first two clauses admit only the simultaneous flip of x and y. On support {x,a,b}, the singleton sign pattern has only the zero translation stabilizer. Intersecting these conditions forces h_x=h_y=h_a=h_b=0, so H(F)={0}.
rigid_core_witness.binary_congruence_progress: The two binary clauses put x and y in the same implication SCC (and not-x with not-y), so x and y are forced equivalent and Q_2 removes one variable.
rigid_core_witness.effect: R44AX acts on formulas already rigid under the R44AW sign-flip invariant.

nonuniversality.obstruction: The exact-width-3 rigid SAT and UNSAT families recorded in R44AW have no width<=2 clauses at all, so B(F) is empty and Q_2 has no nontrivial SCC congruence to consume.

semantic_completion_barrier.statement: Replacing explicit binary implication congruence by the complete semantic equivalence relation of arbitrary F is not a free strengthening.
semantic_completion_barrier.coNP_hardness_argument: Given arbitrary CNF G and two fresh variables x,y, G entails (x iff y) iff G is UNSAT: if G is UNSAT it entails every formula; if G is SAT, extend any model of G with x != y to refute the equivalence. Thus deciding a requested semantic literal equivalence is coNP-hard (and is in coNP via a countermodel witness).

next_admissible_math.question: Find one polynomially computable exact invariant that still makes strict safe progress after both sign-flip quotienting and explicit binary-congruence quotienting have reached fixed point, without DP, branching, proof-search, or hidden terminal SAT.
